mapper.select: select device_id as deviceId, nullif(parent_device_id, 0) as parentDeviceId, device_component_id as deviceComponentId, parent_device_component_id as parentDeviceComponentId, level_no as levelNo, path from ems_device_hierarchy where station_id = #{stationId} and enabled = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by level_no asc, id asc

select date_format(bucket_time, '%m-%d %H:%i') as bucketLabel, avg(case when ifnull(metric_value, 0) < 0 then abs(metric_value) else 0 end) as chargePowerKw, avg(case when ifnull(metric_value, 0) > 0 then metric_value else 0 end) as dischargePowerKw from ems_metric_history_5min where device_id = #{deviceId} and bucket_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 24 hour) and quality = 'GOOD' and metric_key in ('activePower', 'activePowerKw', 'active_power_kw', 'power') group by date_format(bucket_time, '%m-%d %H:%i') order by min(bucket_time) asc
